pairs.title: Norwegian krone in euros
pairs.description: How many euros NOK 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Norwegian krone.
pairs.source: Derived from Federal Reserve H.10 series DEXNOUS and DEXUSEU (FRED) on each trading day: € per NOK 1 = (US$ per NOK 1) ÷ (US$ per €1).

pairs.title: Norwegian krone in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars NOK 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Norwegian krone.
pairs.source: Federal Reserve H.10 (FRED series DEXNOUS) · noon buying rate, New York; 1 ÷ the published NOK per US$.
